items.title: Objection deadline (Einspruch) against the 2024 income tax assessment
items.quote: Legen Sie ihn innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Musterwolgast ein, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The notice is dated 20.11.2026 and states no separate 'Aufgabe zur Post' date, so the posting day is 20.11.2026. Under the post-2025 rule for letters posted on/after 1 Jan 2025, delivery (Bekanntgabe) is deemed to occur on the 4th day after posting: counting 20.11. as day 0, day 1 = 21.11., day 2 = 22.11., day 3 = 23.11., day 4 = 24.11.2026 (Tuesday). Since this is a tax office (§122 Abs.2 Nr.1, §108 Abs.3 AO), if the 4th day fell on a weekend/holiday it would move to the next working day, but 24.11.2026 is an ordinary Tuesday, so Bekanntgabe = 24.11.2026. The one-month Einspruch period (§355 Abs.1 AO) runs from the day after Bekanntgabe (§187 Abs.1 BGB) to the day with the same number in the following month (§188 Abs.2 BGB): 24.11.2026 + 1 month = 24.12.2026 (Thursday). 24 December is a normal working day in Germany (per statutory rule) and not a public holiday in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, so no shift under §108 Abs.3 AO/§193 BGB is needed. Final deadline: 24.12.2026.
